arguments.sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', date) AS INTEGER) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions in each hour of the day, from 0 to 23, based on the hour in the transaction timestamp.
assumptions: Counts cover all transactions, labelled or not, since the question does not mention fraud labels.
Hour is taken from the transaction timestamp as recorded, with no timezone conversion.
Covers the full data period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
